title: Misia's ManaMetalMod Extension
body:
# Introduction

## Foreword

No matter how beautiful the scenery, there will come a day when you've seen it all. No matter how interesting the journey, if you experience it alone, it will eventually become dull. There are always those who dare to take a step forward, to leave the cradle of their home world and embark on an endless journey, wandering through infinite realms, sharing their countless tales, countless objects, and countless techniques with people everywhere...

"Hey~ Have you already seen the sights of another world from that elf lady, nya? Huh? You said you've only seen items, well, close enough! So, how was it? Exciting, right? Technology from another world, equipment from another world, all kinds of things from another world—doesn't just thinking about it make your heart race? Now then, let me tell you all about it, nya!" The strange cat-eared girl shares her knowledge and techniques from other worlds with you.

## Content Summary

Welcome to Misia's ManaMetal Expansion

This is a multifaceted expansion mod for the ManaMetal Mod, extending it across various aspects including accessories, machines, tools, items, and more.

Selected Content Previews + Introductions:

- Filler accessories represented by the Level 5~20 "Universal Emblem" accessory series.
- Expansion and multi-directional development accessories represented by the "Alicia Forged Accessory" series.
- Additional items represented by Production Experience Cards (WIP).
- Practical tools represented by the Sacred Artifact Broom .
- And much more content currently under design!

# Notes

It is highly likely to support all versions of ManaMetal from 7.0 onwards. However, due to minor changes in ManaMetal updates, compatibility across all versions cannot be guaranteed. If you encounter startup crashes with versions lower than the development version, please report it promptly! The version used for development is currently ManaMetal 7.5.1-1. Full compatibility follow-up is generally guaranteed for subsequent versions starting from this one.

Since the MOD is still under development, information about some items in the encyclopedia may not be immediately updated or corrected with minor updates. Please refer to the in-game content for actual effects.

This MOD is still in its early version and the author's skill level is limited. If you have any requests or encounter BUGs, please be sure to provide timely feedback so that issues can be addressed as soon as possible.

# Terms of Use

## For Modpack Creators

Players are free to publish modpacks containing M4E and make them publicly available online for others to download and use.

## For Players

Players may NOT make any direct modifications to M4E. This includes modifying the M4E program itself through decompilation or other means and distributing the modified version. This does not apply to modifying translation files or artwork; such modifications must be clearly marked as "Modified" in the jar filename and info file. However, modifying M4E itself is still not recommended; please achieve visual changes through resource packs whenever possible.

Players may influence the operation of M4E without directly modifying M4E itself (e.g., using a crafting table modifier mod to change M4E's recipes).

Players are free to distribute any version of M4E, provided that distribution does not violate Clause 2 and that no profit is gained from distributing M4E, including but not limited to paid downloads, adf.ly links, etc.

## For Servers

Players are free to host modded servers containing M4E, provided no profit-seeking behavior occurs.

## Other

The right to modify, add to, or remove items from these terms at any time is reserved.

By downloading, playing, or using this mod, the player agrees to all the terms above and agrees to abide by them.

If the player does not agree to these terms, please immediately discontinue use and remove this mod.

Extracting M4E's music and art resources via unpacking or other means is prohibited. Additionally, the copyright for some resources remains with external parties, such as the official ManaMetalMod team. If needed, please inquire with me for the source and then request authorization from the copyright holder.

## Addendum

The above restrictions do not apply to the official ManaMetalMod team, represented by "dragon060810" who hold full authorization by default.
